basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Project Assistant, Project Associate Posts
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi has advertised two project posts, one Project Assistant and one Project Associate II, each on an initial appointment of 3 months. Pay is Rs. 20,000 per month + HRA-I for Project Assistant and Rs. 35,000 per month + HRA-I for Project Associate II. Both posts need a Post-Graduate degree in a relevant field with a minimum of 60% marks. Project Assistant applicants email their CV to [email protected]; Project Associate II applicants fill in a Google form. The last date to apply is 30 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Email your updated CV to [email protected].
Write this as the subject line of the email: Application for Post of Project Assistant in AIIMS, New Delhi - November 2026.
Send the application on or before 30 November 2026.
Fill in the Google form given in the notice at https://forms.gle/zhrguT6rTChPT5c18.
Submit the application on or before 30 November 2026.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. Only short-listed candidates will be called for the interview. The Project Assistant email subject line must be exactly as the notice prints it.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 2 posts in total, one vacancy for each post. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Basic knowledge of working on computers Good at communicating with patients Comfort with handling blood and urine samples Knowledge of Epidemiology and Biostatistics Experience in Systematic Reviews and Meta-analysis Knowledge of research methodology, data analysis and proposal writing Project management and communication skills Good time management and multitasking skills The notice prints no experience requirement as essential for either post. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.
